subject.title: Memory system: Cannot delete stale memories, conflicting entries persist

question: Should this concrete memory-lancedb stale-memory report be fixed narrowly by exposing a deletable recall selector, or folded into the broader memory lifecycle contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42650?
rationale: Source inspection proves a deletion-handoff gap, but automatic replacement/deprecation and durable conflict semantics affect memory API, privacy, and plugin contract direction.

options.title: Narrow recall selector fix
options.body: Expose a model-visible UUID or equivalent stable deletion handle in memory_recall while leaving replacement/deprecation semantics for the broader design.

options.title: Fold into Memory MVP
options.body: Treat deletion handles, non-destructive forget, tombstones, and conflict resolution as one lifecycle design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42650.

options.title: Defer memory cleanup changes
options.body: Keep current behavior and require users to use query-based candidate lists or external cleanup until memory lifecycle work is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Narrow recall selector fix
recommendation.body: Expose a model-visible UUID or equivalent stable deletion handle in memory_recall while leaving replacement/deprecation semantics for the broader design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory storage/provenance work and the canonical Memory MVP review make this the best available owner for lifecycle contract direction.
